purchase_price.evidence: Listing 9705059: Torre del Sol, Ciudadela Universitaria–Barbasquillo, 2BR/2BA furnished, 90.35m² interior (138.36m² total), 1 parking. Asking $139,000. Marketed for year-round Airbnb.

monthly_rent.source: FazWaz 2BR Manta median ~$732; oceanfront 2BR comps; AirROI Manta STR
monthly_rent.evidence: FazWaz 2BR Manta median ~$732 LTR. Listing targets Airbnb year-round with beach access, pool, rooftop BBQ, tennis shared with MantaHost. Oceanfront 2BR comps and Poseidon 2BR rents cluster $1,200-1,300 (often including alicuota). AirROI Manta avg STR only $342/mo — top-quartile needed for $1,200. Used $950 (range $800-1,200) as mid between solid LTR and optimistic STR.

hoa_monthly.evidence: Subject listing does not disclose alicuota. A different Torre del Sol 1BR listing cites HOA $105/mo. Subject is larger 2BR (90m²) with beach/pool/tennis amenities — estimated $120-180/mo; used $140. Status ESTIMATED pending verification from building admin.

special_assessments.evidence: No assessment disclosed. Existing beach-access condo; capital projects possible. Not verified zero.

property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador impuesto predial is 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value (typically well below market). Comparable Manta condos often pay $100-400/yr. For ~$139,000 market price, estimated $111-417/yr; used $175. Exact bill depends on Manta municipal rate and cadastral assessment.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is typically included in Ecuador alicuota. Owner contents/liability: ~$140-210/yr base; Manta coastal earthquake risk adds 15-20%. For ~$139,000 condo, estimated $200-400/yr supplemental owner policy; used $325.

management_annual.evidence: STR full-service management in LatAm commonly 15-30% of gross. At estimated $950/mo ($11400/yr), 18% = $2052/yr. Co-hosting or self-management would reduce this.

utilities_annual.evidence: For long-term Ecuador rentals, electricity/water/internet are typically tenant-paid. For STR, utilities are usually recovered in nightly rates or included in management fee. Owner direct cost assumed $0 under standard lease; if owner-paid budget $600-1,500/yr.

other_expenses_annual.evidence: Furnished unit marketed for Airbnb: FF&E reserve and turnover supplies. Estimated $400/yr beyond management.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Listing explicitly pitches living or vacation rental (Airbnb year-round). No restriction found; confirm building rules.

str_restrictions.evidence: STR actively marketed. City regulation Low. Building-level STR rules unknown — confirm with HOA.

notes: HOA estimated from sibling 1BR listing ($105) scaled up — still not VERIFIED. Rent path depends heavily on STR outperformance vs AirROI averages. Material unknowns: HOA confirmation, assessments, STR bylaws.
